text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while we were
training for the Hopeful Stakes.
choice_data_list: You climb the hill twice in the Hopeful S.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The hill...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes is a 2000m turf race
held at Nakayama Racecourse.
Because of that, the starting point is on the straight before the hill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, they will have to climb the exact same hill twice:
right after the start and just before the finish line. In a battle between Junior-class runners unfamiliar with racing, this will be the key.
choice_data_list: For the first time, just get a feel for the slope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Focus not on the initial battle for position,
but on the second scramble at the finish line.
That will be the shortcut to victory—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sensation...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What kind?
choice_data_list: You need to get a grasp of your stride when going uphill.
You need to get a grasp of your stride when going uphill, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Stride length...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I had formulated a counter-strategy
for the Hopeful Stakes, but it seems my explanation
didn't quite get through just now.
choice_data_list: Which part was confusing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... well, um...
It's not really about any specific part...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Everything.
choice_data_list: I see...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, how should I put it...
Strategies and stuff really aren't for me...
choice_data_list: Do you realize you have to climb the hill twice?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even I get that much.
I might be stupid, but aren't you underestimating me a bit much?
choice_data_list: So was the first hill just a test run?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...A trial run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To convey my intentions,
I take her to a sloped riverbank.
choice_data_list: Try climbing with wider strides than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...? Sure, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... So?
choice_data_list: Next, quick and fine movements—keep a ta-ta-ta-ta rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? If there was going to be a second round,
you should've said so earlier~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while complaining, Tosen Jordan
charged up with full momentum from the bottom of the slope.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That might've been easier than before.
choice_data_list: Taking shorter strides makes it easier to run up hills.
Taking shorter strides makes it easier to run up hills, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're hearing this for the first time,
but she must have been doing it naturally whenever she ran up the training hill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, on hills you don't normally run on—like the slope by the riverbank this time—you can't know the proper stride length beforehand.
choice_data_list: I think it'll be the same on race day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Because the slope at Nakayama Racecourse
is different from the training course's slope...?
choice_data_list: Right, that's why we're testing it out!
Right, that's why we're giving it a try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because the slope is different, the ideal stride length changes too.
So you just have to get a feel for the real thing during the actual race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now, the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The first hill is just a test run.
Use it to find a good stride.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So for the second round, we go all-out sprinting for real!
That's what you mean, right?
choice_data_list: Exactly!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Got it!
I'll do it!
choice_data_list: Now you're fired up.
Now you're fired up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh. If I'm gonna make it big,
1st place here is a given.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I wanna at least take the Classic Triple Crown.
After this comes Satsuki, or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: So you already had our next goal decided too, huh!!
So you already had our next goal decided too, didn't you!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? Don't scream all of a sudden!
You're so loud!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, until recently, she had never thought of any goal other than 'becoming big.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that he specifically brought up the Classic Triple Crown
means he must have researched the races in his own way."
choice_data_list: …So you've been studying on your own, huh.
…So you've been studying on your own, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
First is the Hopeful, after all!
I'm heading out! See ya!!
